text: True or False: If a ∣ b and a ∣ c, then a divides every integer linear combination mb + nc (for all integers m, n).
explanation: True — this is the linearity property of divisibility: b = a·k₁ and c = a·k₂ give mb + nc = a(mk₁ + nk₂), which a divides. It is the workhorse behind gcd and Bézout arguments.
